lateChanukahAndTu.originalHebrew: וּכְמוֹ שֶׁשָּׁמַעְתִּי מֵרַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ זְכַר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא:
lateChanukahAndTu.originalEnglish: and as I heard from our holy master [Rabbi Simchah Bunim of Peshischa], memory of the holy righteous be blessed:
lateChanukahAndTu.replacementEnglish: and as I heard from our holy master, memory of the holy righteous be blessed:
lateChanukahAndTu.reason: Neither the author’s Hebrew here, the printed PDF182, nor the matching report in PeriTzadik Kedoshim12 names Rabbi Simchah Bunim. Remove only the unsupported bracket; do not assign another teacher.

lateChanukahAndTu.originalHebrew: שֶׁזּוֹ נִיתְּנָה בְּג׳ בְּרִיתוֹת וְזוֹ נִיתְּנָה נֶגֶד כָּל הַשְּׁבָטִים אַחַר שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּק יוֹסֵף לְב׳.
lateChanukahAndTu.originalEnglish: for one was given with three covenants, and the other was given corresponding to all the tribes after Joseph was divided into two.”
lateChanukahAndTu.printedHebrew: שזו ניתנה בשלש בריתות וזו ניתנה בשלש עשרה בריתות. והמכוון במילה שניתנה בשלש עשרה בריתות נגד כל השבטים אחר שנתחלק יוסף לשנים.
lateChanukahAndTu.proposedHebrew: שֶׁזּוֹ נִיתְּנָה בְּשָׁלֹשׁ בְּרִיתוֹת וְזוֹ נִיתְּנָה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה בְּרִיתוֹת. וְהַמְכֻוָּן בַּמִּילָה שֶׁנִּיתְּנָה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה בְּרִיתוֹת נֶגֶד כָּל הַשְּׁבָטִים אַחַר שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּק יוֹסֵף לִשְׁנַיִם.
lateChanukahAndTu.proposedEnglish: for one was given with three covenants and the other with thirteen covenants. The meaning of circumcision being given with thirteen covenants is that they correspond to all the tribes, after Joseph was divided into two.
lateChanukahAndTu.reason: Printed PDF365 (שעג), main text right column, has the thirteen-covenants clause and the explanation about circumcision. Both the current reader and the served original Hebrew have dropped this span, leaving an incomplete statement. This is a proposed narrow restoration, not an executed edit.
lateChanukahAndTu.notes: The source’s order of three then thirteen is preserved. The continuation explicitly identifies thirteen with circumcision.
